radiology_report:
Department of Radiology, Antoni van Leeuwenhoek
Date: 15 Dec 2024
Exam: Multiparametric MRI prostate (1.5T)
Clinical indication: Rising PSA (7.4 ng/mL), prior biopsy Gleason 4+3. Evaluate for focal lesion and PI-RADS scoring.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume is 63.0 mL. T2-weighted images demonstrate a focal hypointense lesion in the left peripheral zone at the apex, measuring approximately 12 mm in greatest dimension. On high b-value DWI, the lesion shows restricted diffusion with corresponding high signal on the ADC map. Dynamic contrast-enhanced imaging reveals early arterial phase enhancement with persistent wash-in. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS v2.1 score 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone apex. Prostate volume 63.0 mL. PSA density 0.117 ng/mL/mL. Clinical T stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.83814454.

previous_notes.author: Dr. K. Bakker (GP)
previous_notes.text: 07 Aug 2023 - Dr. K. Bakker (GP): Patient presented with elevated PSA of 4.9 ng/mL. Transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy was performed. Pathology returned showing Gleason 4+3 adenocarcinoma, ISUP grade group 1, with cribriform pattern and IDC-P in the peripheral zone apex. Patient was referred to urology for further evaluation and management discussion. PSA was repeated in Feb 2024 at 2.3 ng/mL, showing a decrease. Current PSA is 7.4 ng/mL, prompting re-evaluation.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1 (07 Aug 2023): Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+3. The reported ISUP grade group is 1. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone at the apex. Cribriform pattern and intraductal carcinoma (IDC-P) are present.

Biopsy timepoint 2 (22 Dec 2024): Repeat biopsy demonstrates adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+3. The reported ISUP grade group is 1. The tumour remains in the peripheral zone at the apex. Cribriform pattern and intraductal carcinoma (IDC-P) are present.

Summary: The histological trajectory across timepoints shows a stable reported Gleason score and ISUP grade group.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 4.
